LightningComponentBundle.description: Optional one-click deploy/publish/activate of the starter Agent Script agent.

property.name: agentApiName
property.label: Agent API Name
property.description: Developer name of the agent to deploy (matches the afscript static resource).

property.name: agentLabel
property.label: Agent Label
property.description: Display label for the deployed agent.

property.name: staticResourceName
property.label: Afscript Static Resource
property.description: Static Resource holding the agent's Agent Script (.agent) source.

property.name: accessPermSet
property.label: Access Permission Set
property.description: Permission set to grant agent access through (gets a SetupEntityAccess to the deployed bot).

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown on the button card.

property.name: cardDescription
property.label: Card Description
property.default: Installs your starting point — the Employee Agent V1 template — and grants you access.
property.description: Sub-text shown on the button card.
